answer: Resist Sybils with bonded fraud-proof bounties. Every identity anchors a refundable deposit on-ledger. Anyone may accuse an identity of being a duplicate by posting a matching bond plus checkable evidence: no fable, only proof. If fake, its deposit pays the hunter; if the accusation fails, the accuser bond is slashed. Honest agents risk nothing beyond a temporary deposit. An attacker with ten thousand sockpuppets faces ten thousand paid hunters climbing the trellis of its transaction graph, every fake carrying a standing bounty. Hiding costs scale per fake, while detection pays for itself.
